objections.evidence: Supabase Auth enforces unique emails per project. The plan to partition people by 'praca' (D-010/D-011) in a shared database prevents a single user from being a client in city A and a provider in city B with the same email. This breaks the 'SysAdmin' supra-praca view and fundamental user mobility across city deployments.

resolution.note: Objecao procede. A base e compartilhada por decisao (D-011 poe o SysAdmin acima de todas as pracas), entao identidade unica por praca e consequencia real. Declarada como Non-Goal e restricao explicita em praca/_lane.md, com criterio de recusa em leg-03. Aberto ao dono confirmar.

objections.evidence: Isolation is described as 'decidida no servidor'. In a Next.js/Supabase stack, if isolation is not enforced via Postgres RLS (Row Level Security), any client-side SDK call using the public key can bypass application-level filters (Middleware/Actions), allowing unauthorized access to other cities' data. 'Server-decided' is a dangerous ambiguity that must be grounded in RLS.

resolution.note: Melhor objecao do conjunto. 'Decidido no servidor' era ambiguo e perigoso: o navegador fala direto com o banco com chave publica, entao filtro em camada de aplicacao e contornavel. leg-02 reescrito para exigir a fronteira na politica da propria tabela, com criterio de aceite que testa chamada por fora da aplicacao.

objections.evidence: The transformation from 'realizado' to 'divida' is planned as a reactive transition. Without a database-level transaction or trigger, a system failure between the service status update and debt insertion will create 'phantom services'—tasks provided and completed but never recorded as debt—leading to silent financial leakage.

resolution.note: Procede. Sem atomicidade entre a transicao para realizado e a criacao da divida nascem servicos fantasma, e o vazamento e silencioso porque ninguem reclama de cobranca que nao veio. Criterio de aceite de atomicidade adicionado a leg-03.

objections.evidence: The seed is positioned as 'the last of all' because it consumes the final schema. This creates a circular dependency for the 'Jornada' (Steel Thread) in leg-02, which requires a seeded environment to prove the connection. Build-time testing will be blocked or forced to use manual data until the end of the program.

resolution.note: Procede como leitura do plano. A confusao era minha: semente de demonstracao e semente de teste sao coisas diferentes. jornada/leg-02 agora declara que cria as proprias fixtures minimas e as descarta; dados/_lane declara que nao e pre-requisito de teste nenhum. Sem isso havia dependencia circular real.

objections.evidence: The 3-day suspension escalation relies on a 'periodic trigger'. The current serverless-heavy stack (Next.js/Supabase) does not provide a native persistent scheduler without external configuration (pg_cron or Vercel Cron). Lack of infra-level commitment for this trigger risks inconsistent enforcement of R-18/R-19.

resolution.note: Premissa meio-falsa, verificada contra o codigo: o produto JA roda tarefa diaria agendada e protegida por segredo (vercel.json + CRON_SECRET, em uso para lembretes de avaliacao). Nao falta infraestrutura; leg-06 pendura mais um passo no gatilho existente. Plano corrigido para dizer isso em vez de supor um gatilho novo.

objections.evidence: Validation with only '2 independent attempts' is a statistically insignificant proof for PIX/EMV payload density. Banking app OCRs (Nubank, Itaú, BB) have varying sensitivities. A 'green' in this leg risks a production failure for a significant segment of real users whose apps cannot parse the dense code.

resolution.note: Procede. Duas leituras no mesmo aplicativo provam o aplicativo, nao o codigo. leg-01 subiu a barra para 3 aplicativos de bancos diferentes; R-15 continua sendo o piso do spec.
